subject: Discovery recap + quick check on timing and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Henson <laura.h@henson.ai>, Tom Eriksen <tom.eriksen@henson.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + quick check on timing and next steps

Hi Laura / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30‑minute call and a suggested next step: 

Summary of what we learned
- Primary goal: reduce per‑query cost for long‑form summarization in customer support workflows; target throughput ~2k reqs/day, 99th pct latency < 600ms.
- Data constraints: PII scrubbed before sending, logs retained for 30 days.
- Compliance: likely need SOC2 evidence; procurement will confirm retention & audit controls.

Proposed fit & next steps
- Fit: Redwood Dedicated looks like the best fit for predictable throughput and isolation. We flagged two options: Dedicated small pool (2x A10G equiv.) or Hosted with customer VPC proxy for a pilot.
- Next step: 15‑minute alignment to pick the pilot configuration and procurement path. I’m free Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Attached: discovery‑recap (one‑pager) and a rough pricing estimate to help with procurement.

If this isn’t the right priority this quarter, tell me and I’ll circle back later — would still love any feedback on fit.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555‑0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Henson <laura.h@henson.ai>, Tom Eriksen <tom.eriksen@henson.ai>, procurement <procurement@henson.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Quick plan if you’re still considering Redwood — two low‑lift pilots

Laura / Tom / procurement — wanted to put two very small, prescriptive pilot options on the table so procurement can see clear next steps. No obligation; just two paths to make evaluation straightforward.

Pilot A (Minimal risk)
- Hosted API + prefix caching; 1 week evaluation, ingest 10k examples, evaluate latency & cost delta.
- Cost estimate: $1,200 for evaluation usage + engineering support.

Pilot B (Isolation + predictability)
- Dedicated small pool (2 GPUs) reserved for 30 days; Redwood handles kernel tuning + patching.
- Cost estimate: $6,500 for the 30‑day pilot (includes basic onboarding).

Mutual action plan (if you want to move forward)
- Week 0: sign simple SOW for chosen pilot (procurement)
- Week 1: onboarding + first ingest (engineering)
- Week 2: run eval set and agree on success metrics

If this is not the right timing, let me know and I’ll set a follow‑up in Q3. If you’re still on the fence, can you share one quick piece of feedback on fit — what part feels off or what info would help procurement decide?

Thanks — I’ll be out Wed afternoon but otherwise available.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555‑0142

Subject: Re: Quick plan if you’re still considering Redwood — two low‑lift pilots

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear options and the recap. Short update from our side: we’ve just locked our budget for H1 and unfortunately don’t have headroom for a paid pilot right now.

That said, this is still of interest; a couple of notes:
- Priority slipped to Q3 planning cycle due to a change in initiatives.
- Procurement said if we come back with a one‑pager that highlights security/compliance (SOC2 artifacts + log retention) and a small‑scale success metric, they’ll be willing to revisit early in Q3.

Can you send the SOC2 evidence + a one‑page pilot success metric by mid‑May? If so, let’s tentatively plan to pick this back up the week of July 13.

Appreciate the patience.

—Tom
Head of Integrations | Henson Analytics
Tom.Eriksen@henson.ai
